buildPolicy.scope: project module compilation; dependency resolution is separately supervised

nonclaims: The capsule is not claimed to be globally or declaration-level minimal.
External dependencies are locked but are not necessarily vendored for offline use.
Native and operating-system dependencies are not packaged hermetically.
Ladon reports Lean replay evidence and is not an independent proof authority.

resourceLimits.memoryMetric: aggregate process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted repeatedly

resourceObservations.memoryMetric: RSS per process; shared pages may be counted repeatedly
resourceObservations.scope: sampled supervised process tree; Lean processes identified by kernel comm; transient processes may be missed
